ad_info.reference_style: Product ad with framed result photo, icon column and trust bar (pink beauty-supplement style)

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: glossy pink background, ultra-photorealistic woman in short fitted shorts, black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; believable real-life result.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line icons inside white-outlined circles, handwritten script accents with small hearts, soft leaf shapes in the background, real aguaje fruits with halved orange flesh.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold uppercase for headline and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, casual handwritten script for emotional accents.

creative_objective: Promise more curves in the glutes without living in the gym, proven by a framed real-looking photo of a woman's fuller glutes and thighs next to the bottle and its natural fruit.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Centered stacked headline with the giant last word. 2) Framed photo of the woman on the right. 3) The bottle with aguaje fruits. 4) Icons, bottom bar and script lines.
art_direction.composition_style: Centered headline across the top; below, three zones left to right: icon column, bottle, framed photo; bottom row with a two-cell bar on the left and script text on the right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline occupies the top 30%; framed photo on the right 45% of the width from below the headline to just above the bottom; bottle center-left; generous gaps around the icons.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Glossy highlight on the bottle, natural indoor light inside the framed photo, soft shadows under the bottle, fruits and frame.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Fuchsia-to-pink background with soft leaf shapes. Top center: a deep magenta rounded pill with white uppercase text, under it a large white uppercase line, under it a giant fuchsia uppercase word with a thick white outline. Left column: three outlined circles with line icons, each with a short uppercase label. Center-left: the product bottle large and upright, with fresh aguaje fruits (one cut in half showing orange flesh) and green leaves at its lower-left base. Right: a vertical photo with rounded corners and a thin white border showing a woman from a 3/4 rear view from waist to knees in textured pink short shorts; above the photo a handwritten two-line script with a small heart. Bottom-left: a deep magenta rounded bar with two cells (icon + uppercase text) separated by a thin divider. Bottom-right: a handwritten two-line script.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Fuchsia #E6177F to bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 with soft lighter leaf shapes
Pill + white line + giant outlined word
Three white-outlined circles with white line icons and uppercase labels
The user's bottle exactly as in the attached photo
Real aguaje fruits (scaly reddish-brown skin), one halved with orange flesh, and green leaves
Ultra-realistic woman, 3/4 rear view waist to knees, short textured pink shorts, fuller glutes and thighs
Deep magenta script with small heart
Deep magenta bar with two icon+text cells, truthful texts

forbidden_additions: Any brand logo other than the label printed on the bottle
Price, discount, stars, ratings, testimonials or extra badges
Extra icons or benefit lines beyond the three in the column

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement ad on a fuchsia (#E6177F) to bubblegum pink (#FF8CC0) background with soft lighter leaf shapes. TOP CENTER, stacked and centered: a deep magenta (#B0105E) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text 'SIN VIVIR EN EL GIMNASIO'; below it a large white bold uppercase line 'MÁS CURVAS EN TUS'; below it the giant bold uppercase word 'GLÚTEOS' in fuchsia with a thick white outline and a soft shadow, the largest text in the ad. LEFT EDGE, below the headline: a vertical column of three circles outlined in white with thin white line icons (a rounded glutes silhouette, a leg silhouette, a leaf), each with a short white bold uppercase label below. CENTER-LEFT, large and upright: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. At the bottle's lower-left base: three fresh real aguaje fruits with shiny scaly reddish-brown skin, one cut in half showing bright orange flesh (#D9572B), and a few green leaves. RIGHT SIDE, from below the headline almost to the bottom: a vertical photo with rounded corners and a thin white border. Inside it, an ultra-photorealistic real Latina woman in her late 20s photographed at home from a 3/4 rear view, framed from the waist to the knees, wearing very short textured (scrunch) dusty-pink fitted shorts and a black top; her glutes are clearly full, round and lifted and her thighs thick and toned, visibly voluminous yet natural and believable, filling about 65 percent of the photo. Maximum realism: real skin texture with visible pores, fine natural creases, subtle skin tone variation, realistic fabric texture, soft window daylight, shot on a full-frame camera; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit fitness-fashion styling. Above the framed photo, a deep magenta handwritten script in two lines with a small heart. BOTTOM-LEFT: a deep magenta rounded bar with two cells separated by a thin white divider: left a white capsule icon with white bold uppercase text, right a white house icon with white bold uppercase text. BOTTOM-RIGHT: a deep magenta handwritten script in two lines. Include only these elements and texts.

mandatory_visual_elements: Fuchsia-to-pink background with soft leaf shapes
Deep magenta headline pill and giant white-outlined word
Three white-outlined circles with line icons in a left column
The real product bottle from the attached photo at center-left
Real aguaje fruits, one halved with orange flesh, and green leaves at the bottle base
Rounded white-bordered vertical photo of an ultra-realistic woman from a 3/4 rear view in very short textured pink shorts, with visibly fuller glutes and thighs
Deep magenta two-cell bottom bar with white icons
final_generation_exclusions: No brand logos other than the label on the bottle; no other supplement brands
No prices, discounts, stars, ratings or testimonials
No cartoonish, exaggerated or surgical-looking body proportions; no nudity
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia), perfectly spelled with accents.
